checklist.title: Your first steps
checklist.subtitle: Five steps and your center is fully running on Edura.
checklist.allDoneBody: Your center is running. You can hide this checklist now.

profile.title: Complete your center profile
profile.body: Name, address and contact number — this is what students and parents see.

teacher.title: Add your first teacher
teacher.body: Send an email invite; the teacher sets their own password.

group.title: Create your first group
group.body: Subject, grade, schedule, hall and price.

student.title: Register your first student
student.body: Straight from the counter — the student gets a link to finish signing up.

payment.title: Record your first payment
payment.body: Cash at the counter or online — both land in the same ledger.

teachers.title: No teachers yet
teachers.body: Add your first teacher so you can create groups and build the schedule.

classes.title: No groups yet
classes.body: A group is what ties a teacher to a subject, a schedule, a hall and a price.

students.title: No students yet
students.body: Register a student at the counter and they'll get a link to complete their details.

payments.title: No payments yet
payments.body: As soon as you record cash or a student pays online, it appears here with its receipt.

rooms.title: No halls yet
rooms.body: Add your halls so you can schedule groups and set hall pricing.
